EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a single X–H stretch at 3511 cm⁻¹, consistent with an O–H stretch shifted down from the free OH region by H‑bonding (GFQ-001, ENV-001), and no evidence for NH2/NH multiple bands expected for amines. Aromatic C–H stretches appear at 3082 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003). Strong bands at 1281, 1146 and 1078 cm⁻¹ fit phenolic C–O stretching and aryl C–F stretches typical for difluorinated aromatics. The intense 864 and the 732 cm⁻¹ bands are consistent with heteroaromatic C–H out-of-plane and ring/CF deformations expected for a difluorinated, OH-substituted azine. Candidate 1 (a difluorinated pyrimidinol) uniquely provides a phenolic OH without NH and allows intramolecular O–H···N interaction (explaining the 3511 cm⁻¹ shift), matching the observed pattern better than OH-free or NH-containing alternatives.
